derivation: Building-block variants of Vanilla materials (shapes, cracked/mossy, Blue Nether Bricks, hushed and sculk deepslate), crafted cheaply from their base block; like Vanilla building blocks they are not traded. The four gravity blocks moved here from SimpleBuilding with the same rows (b-blocksmove); they keep their wandering-trader offer.
